Vavelian Tender Leaf.description: A young leaf from tree species native to the Vavelian continent. Restores 25 HP.

Vavelian Leaf.description: A leaf from tree species native to the Vavelian continent. Restores 50 HP.

Elixir.description: A mixture of Vavelian herbs. Restores all HP.

Health Shard.description: A gem used in rituals, has a weird effect on the human body. Increases max health by 15.

Health Shard II.description: A stronger gem used in rituals, has a weird effect on the human body. Increases max health by 30.

Strength Potion.description: A mixture of Vavelian protein. Increases attack by 20.

Nuuk Feather.description: A feather from a Nuuk bird. Increases agility by 10.

Nuuk Beak.description: A beak from a Nuuk Raptor. Increases agility by 30.

Nuuk Soup.description: A mixture of different parts of a Nuuk bird. Increases agility by 50.

Turtle Shell.description: A shell from a turtle. Increases defense by 15.

Red Turtle Shell.description: A shell from a red turtle. Increases defense by 30.

Lalaque Flower.description: A fresh flower from the Vavelian continent. Used for adding aroma to dishes.

Pincer.description: A pincer from a Big Red Ant. Very sharp and highly poisonous.

Vavelian Sap.description: Sap found from tree species native to the Vavelian continent. Has medicinal purposes.

Slime Pudding.description: A weird substance a slime collapses to when it dies. Extremely lethal to certain species.

Coal.description: A fuel source found in the Vavelia Mine. Good for cooking.

Tusk.description: A tusk from a wild boar. Used for making weapons.

Blaze Ring.description: A scorching ring a blaze expels when dying. Used as a near permanent heat source.

Vavelia Orb.description: An orb blessed with the spirits of Vavelia. Emits a strong purifying aura.

Ice Orb.description: An extremely frigid substance made from a complicated geologic and thermodynamic process.

Fire Orb.description: An extremely scalding substance made from a complicated geologic and thermodynamic process.

Seed Orb.description: An extremely verdant substance made from a complicated botanical and phototrophic process.

Jacket.description: A moldy jacket. Lets you explore cold areas.

Lantern.description: A handcrafted lantern that seems to be made of aromatic wood. Lets you explore dark areas.

Grapple.description: A grapple made out of cooled down magma. Lets you explore high areas.
